text: The Brown-Bethe maximum near 1.5 times the Sun's mass is dead as a literal prediction. The earlier particle physics links are under serious doubt through this chain. The heavy star limb did not individually falsify them at our strict standard. Cosmological natural selection loses the flagship neutron star prediction used here, but the hypothesis itself is not thereby refuted. It can leave this Brown-Bethe route behind at the price of no longer being tested by this channel. And Black Hole Universe names several disagreeing programs, so saying the whole family is falsified would be false.
